description: Pandarus is a GIS toolkit for regionalized life-cycle assessment. Its developers use spatial overlays to align the geography of inventory activities with impact-characterization maps in Brightway-based analysis. The JOSS paper describes this geometry-processing role; the own repository and three-condition LICENSE file establish BSD-3-Clause and free code. The README still calls the licence BSD-2-Clause, so the own licence text controls this draft. Spatial coverage and resolution come from the supplied inventory polygons or raster maps; temporal coverage follows the LCA inventory and scenario period. Infrastructure modellers could prepare location-sensitive material or supply-chain burdens for asset-construction scenarios. A caveat is that an overlay does not validate inventory quantities, emissions factors or causal impacts. Coarse source geometry can hide local variation. Brightway and its datasets are separate dependencies with their own terms. No directly related catalogue record was found. The article and own repository were read without obtaining LCA databases or running an assessment.
name: Pandarus regionalized LCA GIS
notes: G5 G5-0845. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
